mapPrecisionReasonA.code: function mapPrecisionReasonA(o){if(!o)return '선택 없음';if(emconActive)return 'EMCON';if(o.kind==='ESM')return '위치 없음(방위만)';if(o.kind!=='TRACK')return '로컬 트랙 없음(공유만)';const tr=tracks.get(o.id);if(!tr||!mapTrackVisibleA(tr))return '트랙 소실';if(shipEquipmentOfflineV1())return '함 장비 오프라인';if(!Object.values(getSPY1DVFaceStatus()).some(Boolean))return 'SPY 레이더 오프라인';if(!isInRadarSector(tr.x,tr.y,tr.z))return 'SPY 섹터 밖';return '';}
